details.s: Celebrían (IPA:) was an Elven noblewoman, the daughter of Celeborn and Galadriel, the wife of Elrond, and the mother of Elladan, Elrohir, and Arwen.
f: Lady of Lothlórien, Lady of Rivendell
Falmari (House of Olwë), Sindar (House of Celeborn), Ñoldor (House of Finarfin), Elves of Rivendell, Galadhrim, Elves of Eregion
